rawFindings.title: registerBodyParser throws for valid parser registrations
rawFindings.explanation: The function parameter was renamed to `protoype`, but this line still references `prototype`, which is not defined in this scope. For any non-empty MIME string, evaluating the condition raises a ReferenceError before the parser can be registered.
rawFindings.suggestion: Use the same parameter name consistently, e.g. `function(mime, prototype)` and assign `BODY_PARSER_MAP[mime] = prototype`, or change the validation to `util.isFunction(protoype)`.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Calling `RequestHandler.registerBodyParser('application/xml', function XmlParser(){})` throws `ReferenceError: prototype is not defined` instead of returning true and registering the parser.
